claim_results.limit: One exact GLM 5.3 bridge source envelope was admitted under the R9 8,192-token/300-second/2-MiB grant. This proves the bounded returned artifact and its provenance, not live Mattermost behavior or general remote-model reliability.

The tests claim and request occurred only after exact bridge readiness and contained the exact new bridge bytes. Native controls held the tests effect for a truncated bridge. This finite dependency does not prove arbitrary workflow orchestration.

The two exact model products assembled unchanged into quarantined mattermost-r9, passed syntax, model-authored PLUnit, independent process execution, forbidden-core and causal controls. Qualification is design/authorship evidence only; external failure recovery, restart persistence, activation and promotion remain unproven.

No diagnostic, fallback model identity, local-model load, Docker mutation, Mattermost network, credential disclosure, core access, activation or promotion occurred.
